title: Éléments de géométrie algébrique (EGA) — Édition française diplomatique cumulative / Cumulative Diplomatic French Edition
description:
Lire d'abord / Read first: open 00_EGA_FR_CUMULATIVE_LINKED_READER.pdf. This complete cumulative direct-NUMDAM diplomatic release contains EGA I (including Chapter 0), II, III-1, III-2, and IV-1 through IV-4.

The printed French is preserved diplomatically. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, inverses, build evidence, visual QA and SHA-256 manifests are preserved in the language release. Revision r8 normalizes the final inherited CRLF-bearing source paths to UTF-8/LF without changing TeX tokens, diplomatic text, or reader PDFs.
